capabilities.text: Write an inequality's endpoint values above the line, or leave them off
capabilities.note: Settled on the live page: each row's Values above the line (Write/None, Write by default) puts an endpoint's value above its circle when it falls between numbered ticks (-2.5 < x <= 5.3 shows -2.5 and 5.3; at -2 and 5 nothing extra). verSHion writes no endpoint values for an inequality.
